correctness.rationale: Over algebraic closure of F13, y³=x⁵+a x²+1 is smooth iff a⁵≠2 and genus4 by six tamely totally ramified branch points. The Cartier basis has one 1×1 block −a and a 3×3 block M(a) with determinant 3a(a⁵−2)²; independent polynomial coefficient extraction modulo13 reproduced the determinant. Hence Cartier invertible at every smooth a≠0. At a=0 its rank is 2, nilpotent block has cube zero and stable p-rank zero with a-number 2. Jacobi-sum Stickelberger fractional carries over 13 mod15 yield four slopes 1/4 and four slopes 3/4; independent exact fraction carry counts (u1 all one, u2 all three). External Jacobi-sum theorem explicitly used, not treated as machine certification.
